notes.title: Games Forged in Germany
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]We are happy to announce that our game Cross Country Case is participating in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged in Germany[/url] Steam event, running July 24th - 31st. [/p][p]That's right now, so check it right [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]here![/url][/p][p]We hope you can find yourself some great deals to shorten the time till our next announcement, and in-case you haven't we would be happy if you could wishlist our game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Till next time,[/p][p][/p][p]Space Cat Studio[/p]
